zh.title: 民航局舉辦國際無人機與先進空中交通論壇
zh.summary: 民航局11月23日舉辦國際無人機與先進空中交通論壇，聚焦航空安全規範
body: 交通部民用航空局舉辦的「2026國際無人機及先進空中交通論壇」於11月23日登場。論壇聚焦國際無人機與先進空中交通（AAM）發展，以及國際航空安全規範。
民航局表示，論壇邀請國外民航主管機關與專家分享實務經驗，希望透過交流，促進臺灣無人機產業及相關制度與國際接軌。
民航局指出，電動垂直起降航空器（eVTOL）等新興技術，未來可能拓展都市與區域運輸、緊急救援及偏遠地區交通。先進空中交通從技術研發走向實際營運，仍須建立適航認證、安全監理及空域整合機制。

en.title: Taiwan CAA opens international drone and advanced air mobility forum
en.summary: Taiwan CAA's international drone and advanced air mobility forum opens November 23, addressing aviation safety rules.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration's 2026 international forum on drones and advanced air mobility began on November 23. The forum focused on international drone and advanced air mobility development and an introduction to international aviation safety rules.

Foreign civil aviation authorities and experts were invited to share practical experience. The agency said it organized the forum to help Taiwan's drone industry and related systems align internationally.

The agency said emerging technologies such as electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft could potentially expand urban and regional transport, emergency rescue and transport services in remote areas. A shift from research and development to actual operations requires airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration mechanisms, it said.
